features.title: Menu Improvements
features.summary:
Using the screenshot as a guide.

For icons in the red box, turn this into a toolbar menu that floats within the app window, make it vertical by default and always on top. Allow the user to place it on the top, sides or bottom of the app.

For the icons in the green box, make this part of a menu system that you can tear off and attach to the sides, top or bottom of the of the app, or allow float as a toolbar.

For the icons in the blue box, make this part of a menu system that you can tear off and attach to the sides, top or bottom of the of the app, or allow float as a toolbar.

For the icons in the yellow box, make this part of a menu system that you can tear off and attach to the sides, top or bottom of the of the app, or allow float as a toolbar.

Add a "View" option next to File where you can show/hide these floating menu items.

features.title: Auto-Project File creation
features.summary: An opt-in General setting creates a same-basename .keptcraft sidecar on the first annotation. Opening the image reopens the associated project; Save updates only the project, leaving the source image unchanged.

features.title: Show Keptcraft in the start bar
features.summary: A General setting controls taskbar/window-list visibility for editor, settings and history windows. It is on by default and applies to newly opened windows.
